title: Mixed Event — Picture Perfect! — Episode4 Classmates

meta.Event Outline: When Kamiyama High School's very first Arts Festival is announced, Class 2-A decides to produce a film! It falls to Nene to sit in the director's chair, but will her leadership cut it?

rows.Line: The next day
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Thanks to Miku and the others, my story's mostly all set now...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (There might be a little too much going on... But I guess that can't be helped since everyone gave me so many ideas...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Morning, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... M-Morning, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What's this you're reading?
Oh, could it be...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is it the screenplay for our film?! It's already finished?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: More or less... But I'm not sure you can call it that since it's still pretty rough.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, that's totally fine! You knocked it out so fast! Can I take a look at it...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Uh, sure...
I was actually planning on having everyone read through it later.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Awesome! Alright, how does it start?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you two looking at...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Akito!
The screenplay for our film's sorta done!
Wanna take a look at it with us?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, for the festival?
I don't mind waiting until later...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, come join us!
Kusanagi worked really hard on it, so we should read through it together! Here, sit with us!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I'm coming...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So, this story takes place way in the future...
And a series of disasters has led humanity to the brink of extinction...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Food has become scarce with the land now arid and no longer producing crops, causing great suffering.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Talk about a heavy setting.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: However, a number of the privileged employ cooks from the “Dark Culinary Society” to hoard all the food for themselves so that they can live in luxury.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
One man saw this injustice and stood up...
They call him the “Wandering Cook”. The freedom fighter who's sworn to make food for those in desperate need...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And so, with stomachs rumbling, the battle between the Dark Culinary Society and the Wandering Cook will soon begin...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This story's... Interesting...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, I get how you feel...
It sorta just ended up like this after trying to work in everybody's ideas...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I am recognizing a few that came up...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's amazing, Kusanagi.
You managed to get all those different ideas to work as a coherent story.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I'm not sure coherent is the right word... I asked some friends for help, but I'm still a little worried...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Don't be!
I think it's gonna be really fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I really love how the hero fights to make food for all those in need. That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks...
I'm really glad you feel that way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now that you've drafted a screenplay for us, Kusanagi, we can really get the ball rolling. What else do we still need to come up with...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm still not sure about that either...
I was thinking that we should start by splitting into groups.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Groups?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, all films involve a lot of different people and groups working together. Actors, costume designers, cinematographers, prop designers, editors...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I don't know how we're going to decide the groups... It'd be great if we could have people with knowledge about those fields...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, why not just go ask?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
For example... Tachibana probably knows a ton about designing costumes!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Tachibana...?
She's the one who's always wearing a lot of jewelry and stuff, right?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The thought of talking to her never really crossed my mind since it feels like we live in completely different worlds...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, there she is!
Hey, Tachibana!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Huh...? W-Wait, now...?!
I'm still not ready to...!)

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: You called? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Whoa... Her makeup looks even more conspicuous up close...! H-How am I supposed to talk to her...?)

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
Oh, the director's here.
Is this about the festival?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
U-Umm...
So, we were just looking for someone to talk to about costumes for the film, and your name came up...

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
Really?! You can count on me.
I love designing clothes and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You do...?

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Yup! Gimme just one second...

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
Here, take a look.
It's a little beat up, but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A sketchbook...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, these clothes... Did you design all these...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(And there's dozens of pages...
She's even gone into really fine detail... Which fabrics to use, how to get these shapes and even the concepts for each design.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wow.
You designed all these yourself?

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Yeah, because I wanna become a fashion designer. I try to come up with new ideas every day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And the teachers are constantly on your case about drawing stuff during class.

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
Hey, you don't have to go there!
I mean, An, you're one to talk.

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Anyway, ask me whatever you want about this stuff. I'll be more than happy to help...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Then, let me know once you know what you wanna do.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I see...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Tachibana is working really hard to make her own dream a reality.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See? Why don't we go around to ask what everyone in our class is good at and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, that might be a good idea...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, then...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, everyone! Listen up!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
H-Huh?
What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're really starting now...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, it's faster if we just ask everybody at once!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's some things we wanna ask you guys regarding the arts festival. Do you mind helping us out?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Ooh, is this about our film?

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: Come to think of it, nothing's really been decided yet.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, in order to get it off the ground, we're gonna need to figure out how to film it and edit and stuff. I don't know how to do a lot of those things, so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We wanted to see if anyone in our class does.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: About filming...

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: Oh, I know a few things about shooting films and stuff because it's my dad's hobby!

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: We might have some spare equipment lying around at home. I'll ask to see what he'll let me borrow...!

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line: Like I mentioned the other day, since we're doing an action film, we've got plenty of judo and karate club members ready to help!

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line:
Not just judo and karate. Boxing too...
We've got a lot of skilled martial artists who've been training since they were little!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line: Also, this is a class project. It wouldn't be fair for us to make you do everything, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Amisawa
rows.Line: I agree! We're sorry about not helping you sooner, so please let us know what you need.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Let's make our film a good one, Director!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, thanks...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's all do our best.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah!
